environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) Priority 200 - Custom rule group 'corp-uri-rate-limit' that rate-limits /api/ paths to 100 req/5min per IP, (3) Priority 300 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action and sensitivity level set to HIGH, with no rule action overrides. WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no outbound internet access (VPC endpoints only for ECR/CloudWatch), and the security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, VPC endpoints only
config.outbound: VPC endpoints for ecr.dkr, ecr.api, logs, s3 gateway
